description: OpenStudio Backporter is a Python library contributed by EffiBEM to convert OpenStudio OSM models to older software versions. It exposes both a library interface and a command-line entry point and provides installation instructions through Python package distribution. Public source, examples and documentation are available from the repository, free under MIT. Coverage is the building model supplied by the user, with no fixed geographic location, observation period or spatial resolution. Its role is file-version compatibility, not building-physics simulation. The maintainer explicitly states that backports are added only as far back as needed, so users must check whether their requested version pair is supported. Converting a file also does not establish that all model behaviour is preserved; this review did not run a round-trip or simulation comparison. The tool can help reuse building models when an analysis environment requires an earlier OpenStudio release. It directly supports the catalogue's OpenStudio platform (platform-openstudio), which in turn prepares and runs EnergyPlus models.
